extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants, patent practitioners, patent examiners, and the public seeking USPTO patent process guidance
extracted.subtask_description: An index page listing consolidated laws, rules, manuals, training materials, and archival guidance that apply to the U.S. patent process and examination. Serves as a pointer to the substantive authorities (MPEP, statutes, rules, subject-matter guidance, and historical materials).
